notes.title: 《V-LOVER！》Demo version store page now live！The goal is to nurture the most capable VTuber！
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3694290/VTuberDemo/?beta=0
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/fd8203705f51126e39851503cd1947dda1d7d58d.gif[/img]

[h2][b]【Game Overview】[/b][/h2]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/b5d80fd717ccd9f1ae1cd938a0712eef388e795b.gif[/img]

You are a university freshman who loves watching VTuber live streams. You entered Big Mountain Production by chance and became a manager, meeting three unique VTubers and the actual person behind the character. Over the next year, lead them towards the path of realizing their dreams!
In addition to working hard to earn money and managing channels, you can also leverage your reliable charm as a manager to gradually enter the hearts of the three girls, even developing relationships with them that goes beyond "VTuber and manager"!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/3edb5781b92894cd05ad05d5f035aacddf4d8151.png[/img]

[h2][b]【Game Features】[/b][/h2]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/9b60f0b31d1f2cb93e71a9c9e7ae5b01035beb5f.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Exquisite fully animated H scenes
[*] 25 H scenes
[*] More than 180 CGs including variants
[*] Interactive CG in dynamic
[*] Three-line parallel development system
[*] Full voice acting for the female lead
[*] Dress-up system
[*] Over 150,000 words of text
[/list]

[h2][b]【Game System】[/b][/h2]
[b]-Abundant Nurturing System-[/b]
Players need to arrange the weekly schedules for the three heroines according to their abilities and goals within a year in the game, while paying attention to their physical and mental health. If players fail to relieve their stress in time, irreversible and significant consequences will occur...
Special Date System: Fulfilling specific conditions before a designated date, such as the heroine's birthday, Christmas, or Tanabata, can trigger special storylines!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/f7d9a934dd485c698b74bfdf726209220534f0e4.png[/img]

[b]-Ultra-realistic Live Streaming Scenes-[/b]
With Live2D model and realistic live streaming room settings, players can experience ultra-realistic live streaming.
VTubers will encounter various unexpected events during live streams, and players need to provide appropriate action suggestions based on the heroines' characteristics!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/4ab425419e9ca14ab59ae2a5d0fe6e7fd85552d0.png[/img]

[b]-Master of Time Management-[/b]
To synchronize the nurturing of three VTubers, you need to allocate action points wisely and choose which heroine's growth to witness.
Each training session is accompanied by a corresponding mini-game, and the VTubers can also grow rapidly when you perform well!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/799fbfed51f8c28ee8c65821215d307f2de2707f.png[/img]

notes.title: Update English Interface&Text added《Lunar maiden, River-side Angel, and the Godlike moment》
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43921064/b25aa5e87647590ffc75684dd2188e7a1fcf5ec6.png[/img]
[h3]■ Overview[/h3]
"Lunar maiden, River-side Angel, and the Godlike moment。"
An 18+ novel game set in modern Japan. 
Experience Hidari Takanagi ─ Left's agony of a mentally ill and lonely girl and love at first sight in her POV.
It is recommended for those who want to peek at the divinity born from the ashes of the broken ones.
[h2][b]Come and take a look!![/b][/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2503780?utm_source=announce240502_EN

[h3]■ Story[/h3]
"I will make you real."

Away from her sick father and deceased mother, who committed suicide,
A woman, relying on relatives and welfare assistance, struggling to stay alive on the outskirts ─ Hidari Takanagi.
She aspires to be both an actress and a screenwriter, but no one can understand her because of her ambition. 
She only has herself to talk to.

Meanwhile, a series of bizarre murders shook the world.
Targeting elders and women who live alone, the murderer is considered to be the same because of the gruesome method.
It went viral on all news and SNS platforms.

One day, Hidari finds a young man sitting in a corner of the park on her way home from a convenience store late at night.
Despite his otherworldly beauty and friendliness, he quickly fell in love with Hidari, and Hidari also opened her heart to him.
The two soon started dating.

――The beautiful man never said a word to Hidari, but he was a serial killer.
